app.name: Track Your Leader
app.sampleDataDescription: Officials in this preview are fictional and their trips are illustrative. Countries, offices, cities and international events are real.

search.placeholder: Search a country, leader or minister…
search.title: Search countries and officials
search.empty: No countries or officials match your search.

filters.name: Name

overview.title: Where are leaders travelling?
overview.description: Select a country on the map or below to see its officials, where they have been and where they are going next.
overview.untrackedHint: Countries without tracked officials can still be selected on the map to see the visits they received.
overview.noUpcomingDescription: Nothing scheduled matches the current filters.

country.noOfficialsDescription: Try widening the date range or removing some filters.
country.noTripsDescription: No trips by this country's officials match the current filters.
country.noVisitsDescription: No tracked official visited {country} within the current filters.

official.noTripsDescription: This official has no trips matching the current filters.
official.notFoundDescription: This official is not part of the dataset.

trip.notFoundDescription: This trip is not part of the dataset.
trip.outsideFilters: This trip is outside the current filters, so it is not shown on the map.

map.label: Interactive world map
map.title: World map of official travel
map.instructions: Use plus and minus to zoom, arrow keys to pan, 0 to reset, F to frame the selection and Escape to go back. Countries and officials can also be selected from the panel or with search.
map.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again. Lists and details in the panel still work.
